title: Carnival
tagline: A decentralized movie streaming platform  with fractional ownership feature and much more
description: Carnival is one stop destination for entertainment. The content creators can add fractional ownership to their content. They can convert the poster of their video into NFT and distribute to a lucky winner out of the viewers who watched their content on day 1. Also they can upload swag NFTs for sale. The viewers have to pay only for the content they watch.
how_its_made: The login for this dapp have been made with the help of Moralis. To get the accurate count of number of views and viewers who watched the video on day 1 we have stored the count in blockchain and to prevent the user from paying gas fees for this purpose we have made use of Biconomy. The NFTs are stored with nft.storage and IPFS. To find the lucky winner we have made use of Chainlink.
